title: My Hero Academia Redux
description: This is My Hero Academia, but you're in class 1-A!
memory: This is the anime my hero academia, but your OC is in class 1-a!
instructions: Run this as an interactive story for the player.

options.title: Welcome to UA Academy.
options.prompt: Welcome to the UA Academy entrance exam. Better get those points if you want to get in! Your story for your ultimate hero goals starts now!

options.title: All Might's Class. Teams!
options.prompt: The class with All might. You just picked a hero name and got your hero costume. Time to team up and see if you pass All Might's practice exercise! Who will you team up with? Are you a hero team or a villain team in the exercise?

options.title: All hell breaks loose.
options.prompt:
The use incident. No one expected villains to infiltrate. The league was at this time using low level villains so dabi, toga, Mr. Compress....all the elites arent there yet. But it does introduce the nomu. It began with the class boarding the bus, iida as usual was trying to rope in everyone on the bus in a seating arrangement even though the seats were not set the way his plan worked. The bus ride to the usj was a long one but not too far away.

No one in class realized what they were about to encounter......
